title: Donald Trump taps Vanity Fair to help him launch his comeback
description_short: Donald Trump taps Vanity Fair to help him launch his comeback
description_medium: In December 1993, Donald Trump asked Vanity Fair to profile him as he sought to rebuild his public image. The magazine assigned Edward Klein to spend several days with Trump that month, and published the feature in March 1994. The account describes a request and editorial access, but does not show that Vanity Fair promised promotion or favorable coverage.
description_long: Donald Trump asked Vanity Fair for a profile in December 1993 as he tried to rebuild his public image after business setbacks. The magazine assigned writer Edward Klein to spend several days with him during the month, and published the resulting feature in March 1994. The linked archive quotes Klein describing Trump's belief that the press could “build you back up” after cutting you down, and places the request alongside Trump's financial difficulties and planned public offering, which he expected would make him billions. The piece also discussed his marriage to Marla Maples as part of the public image he was trying to rebuild. The account documents a profile Trump sought and the access Klein received while reporting it. It does not indicate that Vanity Fair entered a promotional agreement or guaranteed favorable coverage. The resulting feature was editorial coverage produced by the magazine; the request and interview access do not establish a business partnership or endorsement.
